svg.title: From pile to point
svg.desc: Eight equal slats, the lines of a pile, are threaded on one post. A reading head on a mast, the question, has read them from the top: three lines turned across to it and glow teal, while the rest stay stacked on the post. Above the question, pinned on the end of the post over the three lines it rests on, sits the point: one slat, lit magenta.
